text.card: A red giant 3,768 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.90 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,014 K at its surface.
